in_sample.why_not_counted: The canonical table identifies 27 route profiles and one OE-W7 scope question, but it does not publish a task-case corpus or profile-authoring membership labels. Counting source excerpts or profiles as tasks would manufacture a denominator.

held_out.separation_rule: A work node is held out only if it belongs to SCP-SI-01, whose 2026-08-27 frozen baseline states that no SCP-SI-01 output pre-existed. This cohort begins more than four days after the route table's last authoring commit. Earlier OE-W8/W9/W10 material is excluded even when its commit timestamp is later than the table, because commit order alone cannot prove that concurrently prepared work was absent from the author's context.

tasks.work_node: Repair the governing CUR-ORCH-QUAL refusal record without creating a second acceptance track.
Extend the hash-chained event log and currentness projections without creating a competing ledger.
Exercise the authority/authorship corpus with a real sidecar worker without replacing the authority index.
Triage the integrated regression harness and 117 portability findings without creating a parallel test suite.
Evaluate the 27 route profiles on held-out work without creating a route registry.
Extend the authorship worker contract without creating a second adapter layer.
Derive accepted-unit economics from cohort history without creating a ceremonial Cycle 0.
Apply the existing independent-acceptance machinery without allowing a producer-authored verdict.

evaluation_contract.unit: one canonical route profile applied to one activated held-out task
evaluation_contract.selector: Route only when the profile itself establishes compatible direction, required content fidelity, a machine-readable return into repository custody, and every stated precondition in the observed held-out run. Otherwise abstain. A same-provider or same-product family is not the same route.
evaluation_contract.rate_rule: Rates are reported only with numerator and denominator. With fewer than 30 independent exercised decisions, the rate is explicitly NOT_ESTABLISHED and the percentage is omitted.
evaluation_contract.evidence_loss_rule: Count a loss only when an exercised route omitted a property listed in that task's required_return_properties and a downstream consumer demonstrably needed it.
evaluation_contract.recovery_rule: Recovery requires an observed corrective route or retry after a wrong route. A documented fallback that was not invoked is not recovery.
evaluation_contract.currentness_rule: Propagation succeeds only when the result reaches the audited integration/currentness projection. A lane-local commit is durable custody but not currentness propagation.

constraints.statement: Exclude every case that cannot be proved absent from profile authoring context.
constraints.defect_caught: CUR-ORCH-QUAL's producer register reported two qualified routes, but independent challenge later refused the aggregate and only R1 survived. Reusing qualification-era cases as held-out would repeat producer evidence as independent proof.

constraints.statement: A route profile abstains unless its own direction, fidelity and preconditions match the held-out work node.
constraints.defect_caught: The R23 evidence records that OE-W6 called the Cursor route absent after probing a guessed 404 path; explicit published-route evidence corrected that false absence.

constraints.statement: Do not report an established rate over this eight-node set.
constraints.quote: if your held-out set is too small to support a rate, report the raw counts and say the rate is not established — a percentage over four samples is theatre

constraints.statement: Keep route failure separate from inability to exercise a route.
constraints.quote: distinguish a route that failed from a route you could not exercise; UNESTABLISHED is a legitimate and useful finding

constraints.statement: A local lane result does not count as currentness propagation until the audited integration projection contains it.
constraints.defect_caught: The SCP-SI-01 baseline's first stale-base map produced five false NOT_FOUND results before the correct return-branch ref was restored.

claims.claim: The canonical table contains 27 route profiles.
No SCP-SI-01 output pre-existed at the 2026-08-27 baseline freeze.
The eight Lane A-H work nodes are separated from the 2026-08-23 profile authoring by the frozen SCP-SI-01 baseline.
The route table is descriptive evidence, not an executable task router.
claims.source: The canonical artifact publishes route capability fields and reproduction commands but no task-classifier, selection function or held-out corpus.
